name: ExampleChapterBanner
title: Chapter banner
description: A banner that names the chapter a space is anchored to, with its region. The props come from the space's anchor, bound on the server.
functionalRequirements: Show the chapter's name and region as a banner. Say so when no chapter was bound.
technicalDesign: A single React function with no data access: everything it shows arrives as props.

properties.name: chapterName
properties.description: The chapter the space is anchored to
